creates_law_reviewed.class: LAW -- amphichirality forces CS to be 2-torsion, sharpening a banked statement
creates_law_reviewed.basis: read at banking: 6/6 exact on the census, and it corrects the reason given for B303's CS=0

claim_one_line: A GATE OF OURS KILLED A POSITIVE, AND THE RECOVERED RESULT IS SHARPER THAN THE ORIGINAL (owner-prompted: 'make sure our gates are not killing positives'). B1222 refuted the symmetry-implies-vanishing thesis using symmetry-group order vs H1 TORSION, r = +0.50 against a predicted negative -- but the thesis is about PHYSICAL vanishing (Chern-Simons, modular flow, values) and H1 torsion is not a quantity it mentions. Refuting a claim on an observable it never made is a category error wearing a correlation coefficient. RE-TESTED ON THE THESIS'S OWN QUANTITY over the first 400 one-cusped orientable census manifolds, splitting on amphichirality (the symmetry the mechanism names) and measuring CS: amphichiral 3/6 = 0.500 have CS = 0; non-amphichiral 1/394 = 0.0025. A FACTOR OF ~200 IN THE PREDICTED DIRECTION -- the mechanism is real. AND THE SHARPER STATEMENT, which is the actual finding: the 3-of-6 is not noise. Amphichirality gives CS = -CS so 2*CS = 0 -- CS IS 2-TORSION, NOT ZERO. In SnapPy's normalisation (CS mod 1/2) the 2-torsion elements are exactly {0, 1/4}, and the census returns exactly that: m004, m136, m206 at 0; m003, m135, m207 at 1/4. SIX OF SIX, EXACT, TWO VALUES ONLY. So the banked 'CS = 0 forced by amphichirality' (B303) is THE SPECIAL CASE: the theorem is CS in {0, 1/4} and m004 happens to sit at 0; B303's conclusion is right for our object and its stated REASON is incomplete. IT ALSO SEPARATES THE SISTERS: the paper says m003 and m004 share field, volume and amphichirality and that 'what separates them is the cusp shape' -- there is a second and arguably more physical separator, m004 at CS = 0 and m003 at CS = 1/4, the two ends of the same 2-torsion set. ON CRITERIA: a kill condition stated in advance is only as good as its OBSERVABLE; B1222's falsifier was pre-registered, run honestly and reported faithfully, and was still wrong because the observable did not belong to the claim. Pre-registration protects against moving the goalposts, not against choosing the wrong goal. The corrective is one added design-time question -- 'is this quantity one the hypothesis actually predicts?' -- asked BEFORE the run, since afterwards it is indistinguishable from special pleading. B1222's NEGATIVE is SUPERSEDED not deleted: its other two tests (7/10 and 6/10, with the regulator being Dirichlet and ell/sigma being missing data) stand, so the thesis is partially supported and not established; what is retracted is that the decisive test refuted it. Gate 5 clean.
